pages.title: A Field That Runs Itself
pages.text: Connect mechanical movement with the farm while leaving native harvesting balance intact.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Mount the harvester on a working contraption facing a mature supported crop. Its native harvesting operation must succeed.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Attach harvesting actors and storage to an assembled moving contraption. Harvest encountered crops and collect products through its actor behavior.
